notes.title: Patch 2.0
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added cloud saves!  You can now save the game at the start of any Defensa level by pressing the save button.  You only have one save slot.  It will save all stats, inventory, and upgrades.  Once a save exists, there will be a "Continue" button on the main menu to resume the game where you left off.  Using the "Continue" button does not delete the save, so you can continue to load that saved game with the "Continue" button.  However, loading a saved game will disable saving your high score to the leaderboard.  Saving again will overwrite the last save.
[*] Modified main menu screen so moving left and right will move the selected button.
[*] Modified the Options screen so it saves the configuration if you exit using the B button.
[/list]

tags.feature: [*] Added cloud saves! You can now save the game at the start of any Defensa level by pressing the save button. You only have one save slot. It will save all stats, inventory, and upgrades. Once a save exists, there will be a "Continue" button on the main menu to resume the game where you left off. Using the "Continue" button does not delete the save, so you can continue to load that saved game with the "Continue" button. However, loading a saved game will disable saving your high score to the leaderboard. Saving again will overwrite the last save.

notes.title: Patch 1.7
notes.content:
[list]
[*]  In the Defensa levels, when the ship changed directions, the scrolling stopped and it resumed once you were 1/3 of the screen length from the edge of the screen.  This resulted in less scrolling when you changed directions, but you could only see 1/3 of the screen length ahead of you and 2/3 rds of the screen behind you.  With this new change, you are always in the center of the screen, (unless you are at the edge of the play field).  This should let the player see what is coming at them from the direction they are moving better.  It also makes  using the teleporter less disorientating, because it no longer does the fast scroll across the play field, it is now instantaneous.
[*] Base shield  parts are less blocky when destroyed.
[*] Shooting the level skip target only gives you 150 metal, instead of 200.
[*] Decreased fire tank missiles damage to base by half.
[*] Fixed a performance issue when the player's ship was re-forming.
[*] Increased volume of sound effect when enemy generators are destroyed during the basement levels.


[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.5
notes.content:
For the second anniversary of the release of "In My Defense"... a new patch! 

[list]
[*]  Player ship explodes with added effects and explosion lasts slightly longer
[*] Fixed lava eruption showing in front of wood guardians.
[*] Adding option to turn off lightning flashes on thunderstorm levels.
[*] Added option to turn off background planets.
[*] Adding impact sound when meteor hits the ground.

[*] New Mystery power-up.  Could be any one of the other power-ups.
[*] Added crescent moon the the background planet pool.
[*] Defensa won't say "Enemy at base!", if the base has been destroyed.  Defensa will now warn when the creeping plant reaches the base.
[*] Reduced maximum size of background planets.
[*] Wood guardians on snow levels now have some snow on their trunk.
[*] Added random supply drop on regular Defensa levels.  The supply crate enters randomly from above anywhere on the playfield.  If it is picked up and brought to the base, the player gets 50 metal.  
[*] Added cables connecting the spider's body with the head.
[*] The metal amount no longer displays in the HUD during endless mode.
[*] New Defensa voice lines.
[*] Added new cloud to the cloud pool.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.3 Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] New enemy- The Steaky Surfer. If killed a certain way, player can steal its weapon, picking the gun up and dropping it like the rock launchers. When attached, the weapon fires along with the normal ship's laser.
[*] Added yellow burst when picking up a power-up.
[*] Improved graphics on player shield. Shield now animates if something hits it.
[*] Added new achievement based on new enemy.
[*] Hawks now tilt up and down. Hawk enemy has had its graphics re-done.
[*] New ability/powerup: The Wood Guardian. It kills enemies with its branches.
[*] Made it so Defensa and Hitch don't talk over themselves as much. Low important voice lines won't play, if another voice line is currently playing.
[*] Changed text to icons for many of the HUD labels.
[*] New power-up: Shrinker- all the firepower, but less of a target. Enemies that fire on or web player when player is near, will not detect player.
[*] New Defensa voice lines, including adding voice lines to the intro sequence.
[*] Updated instruction screens to include new enemies, friendlies, and power-ups.
[*] AI wingman intelligence has been improved. They are much better at bombing ground targets. They each have a limited set of 19 bombs.
[*] Added random size scaling to base cracks to make them look better.
[*] If a powerdown activates a shrinker powerup, the player's ship will be twice the normal size for a short period. If the powerdown activates a wood guardian powerup, an evil wood guardian will appear.
[*] Spider body and head graphics slightly enhanced.
[*] Mist added to some storm levels.
[*] Added Attack Saucer. It launches from the base side of the playfield. If it make it to the edge of the left side of the playfield, it will drop a rolling bomb towards the base. The rolling bomb can only be destroyed by a bomb.
[*] Changed ship graphics so it tilts when going up or down.
[*] Removed small moon and sun. Added random large planets to background. The planets will stay in that configuration until a new game is started.
[*] Destroyed ships now drop metal, which can be collected. Before every basement level, there will be a store to buy ship upgrades that you can pay for in metal.
[*] Changed death of the planter. It used to turn black for a second. Now, pieces of it shimmer to the ground.
[*] The spider legs now fly off in pieces when destroyed.
[*] All saucer types now have a debris explosion when hitting the ground.
[*] Nightwing animation redone to be smoother.
[*] Added death animation for spores.
[*] Twin stick basement levels.[list]
[*] Dead Hacker sprite that flies up at the screen has been redone to be higher resolution.
[*] Fixed issue with initial wave pause screen, so player can no longer move while paused.
[*] Fixed issue with gas explosion achievement that had a bug, making it too easy to achieve.
[*] Added sand traps that slow down everyone moving over them, except drones.
[*] Droids now move to center of playfield after player dies.
[*] Added new enemy, Generator Spawner. It moves around the playfield dropping enemy generators.
[*] Added death animation for blobs.
[*] Added alternate death animation for ensects.
[*] Changed the ensects path to the power generators so it is not a direct path. This will make it so less of them are clumped exactly on top of each other. Also changed it so more will be at remote power generators.[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
Patch 1.1
New enemies for the new year!

Super Saucer added. Acts like regular saucer with added upgrades. Blue instead of red, a little faster than regular saucer, can teleport ahead a short distance, and will avoid laser fire.

Warpillar - tunnels in from below. You must bomb it three times. If you don't kill it in time, it will form an indestructible cocoon. After a short period of time, a Buzzkill will emerge from the cocoon, to hunt you down.

Changed bomb power-up to give you 20 bombs, instead of 9.
Spider now shoots lasers at base, when near it.
Added enemy point values to instruction screens.
Added new third enemies screen to instruction menu to describe new enemies.
Re-balanced music volumes.
